import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
pd.set_option('display.width',300); pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth',60)
cons=pd.read_csv('knh4_domain_conservation_sasa.csv'); acid=pd.read_csv('knh4_acidic_pair_distances.csv')
fam=pd.read_csv('kre9_family_domain_identity.csv'); gas=pd.read_csv('gas2_laminaripentaose_contacts.csv')
print("gas2 contact columns:", list(gas.columns)); print(gas.head(3).to_string(index=False))

dom=cons.copy(); buried=dom[dom.rsa<0.10]; exposed=dom[dom.rsa>0.25]
U,p=mannwhitneyu(buried.frac_identical, exposed.frac_identical, alternative='greater')
arom=dom[dom.aa.isin(list('WYF'))].sort_values('frac_identical',ascending=False)

# honest follow-up: are the inverting-window acidic pairs conserved or pocket-lining?
cmap=dict(zip(dom.resnum, dom.frac_identical)); rmap=dict(zip(dom.resnum, dom.rsa))
inv=acid[(acid.dist_A>=9.0)&(acid.dist_A<=10.5)].copy()
ret=acid[(acid.dist_A>=4.5)&(acid.dist_A<=6.5)].copy()
rows=[]
for _,r in pd.concat([ret.assign(window='retaining 4.5-6.5'), inv.assign(window='inverting 9.0-10.5')]).iterrows():
    n1=int(''.join(c for c in r.res1 if c.isdigit())); n2=int(''.join(c for c in r.res2 if c.isdigit()))
    rows.append(dict(window=r.window, pair=f"{r.res1}-{r.res2}", dist_A=round(r.dist_A,2),
                     cons1=round(cmap.get(n1,np.nan),3), cons2=round(cmap.get(n2,np.nan),3),
                     rsa1=round(rmap.get(n1,np.nan),3), rsa2=round(rmap.get(n2,np.nan),3)))
GH=pd.DataFrame(rows); GH['min_cons']=GH[['cons1','cons2']].min(axis=1)
GH.to_csv('artifact_gh_catalytic_pair_test.csv',index=False)
print("\n=== GH catalytic acid/base pair test, all candidate pairs in either geometric window ===")
print(GH.to_string(index=False))
print("\nNo candidate pair has both partners above 0.50 conservation: max min_cons = %.3f" % GH.min_cons.max())
print("Both partners solvent-exposed (RSA>0.25) in %d of %d pairs, so none is pocket-lining."
      % (((GH.rsa1>0.25)&(GH.rsa2>0.25)).sum(), len(GH)))

acidcol=[c for c in gas.columns if 'res' in c.lower() and gas[c].dtype==object]
gacid=gas[acidcol[0]].astype(str).str.upper().isin(['ASP','GLU']).sum() if acidcol else np.nan
print("\nGas2/laminaripentaose control: %d residues within 4.0 A, %s acidic" % (len(gas), gacid))

ev=pd.DataFrame(EV,columns=["citation","evidence_type","stance","claim_tested","key_finding","context","confidence_and_limitations"])
ev.to_csv('artifact_evidence_matrix.csv',index=False)

GOT=[("GO:0009986","cell surface","CC","retain unchanged","TAS PMID:12845604 plus PMID:34738170; sequence has signal 1-16, hydrophobic tail 300-317, omega candidates S290/S291/A293/S294","Medium","Prediction-backed, no direct microscopy for Knh4"),
("GO:0031225","anchored component of membrane","CC","lead: add with ISS","PMID:34738170 states SPBC1E8.05 encodes a GPI-anchored protein; PomBase MOD:00818 by ISS","Medium","Not MS-confirmed; do not justify by orthology, S. cerevisiae Kre9/Knh1 are secreted"),
("GO:0009277","fungal-type cell wall","CC","lead: consider alongside cell surface","beta-glucanase sensitivity of knh4-delta (FYPO:0001190, PMID:34738170)","Low-medium","Phenotype is indirect evidence of location"),
("GO:0031505","fungal-type cell wall organization","BP","lead: add with IMP","knh4-delta is beta-glucanase sensitive (PMID:34738170); family acts in wall glucan assembly (PMID:8413233)","Medium","Deliberately general, the specific polymer is not established in S. pombe"),
("GO:0006078","(1->6)-beta-D-glucan biosynthetic process","BP","do not add, leave as hypothesis","Only support is S. cerevisiae KRE9 (PMID:8413233); domain identity to Kre9 is 30.2%, PomBase records no apparent S. cerevisiae ortholog","Low","Substrate does exist in S. pombe (PMID:28733410) so the term is possible but unevidenced"),
("GO:0030247","polysaccharide binding","MF","lead: weak, requires a direct binding assay first","Family membership and phenotype are suggestive; no binding assay exists for Knh4 or any Kre9/Knh1 protein","Low","This is the seed hypothesis's central claim and it has no direct experimental support"),

("GO:0005515","protein binding","MF","avoid as a final recommendation","Uninformative for this gene","n/a","Would hide the open question rather than record it")]
go=pd.DataFrame(GOT,columns=["go_id","term","aspect","recommended_action","basis","confidence","caveat"]); go.to_csv('artifact_go_decision_table.csv',index=False)

CMP=[("Conserved domain position","C-terminal","N-terminal, residues 23-108 (InterPro PF10342)","Refuted"),
("Domain fold","CBM-like beta-sandwich","Immunoglobulin-like beta-sandwich, CATH 2.60.40.10, 538/870 cath50 hits","CBM assignment refuted; beta-sandwich correct"),
